# The Last Flights

*The far cove stair's last flights run down past the Wrack Ledges. Thin the Saltgulls there and the Sea Newts on the Saltface, then take Gorm's word to Kestra about a handrope.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Gorm](../npcs/gorm_stairs.md) |
| Level | 44 |
| After | [The Far Cove Stair](../quests/gorm_the_far_cove_stair.md), [Below the Anvil](../quests/gorm_below_the_anvil.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 50 [Saltgull](../monsters/saltgull.md) in [The Wrack Ledges](../maps/wrack_ledges.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Sea Newt](../monsters/sea_newt.md) in [The Saltface](../maps/saltface.md)
3. Talk to [Kestra](../npcs/kestra_bridges.md)

## Rewards

- 26,500 EXP
- 1,800 mesos
- [Saltface Helm](../items/saltface_helm.md) x1
- +30 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Gorm](../npcs/gorm_stairs.md)
